APP

#### Integrate anything

Bring your organization's unique data to Jira and Confluence. Connect backend services, specialized tools, and more, all in one unified experience.

[Build your integration](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/building-integrations/)

## Extend Atlassian, your way

Create apps and AI agents with powerful, developer-grade tools

![Develop with Forge](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/develop-with-forge.svg)

CUSTOMIZE AND EXTEND

### Develop with Forge

Build, deploy, and host custom apps on Forge. Unlock deep extensibility with developer-grade tools with built-in security and effortless scaling.

[Get started with Forge](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/)

![Forge CLI icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/Art.svg)

#### Forge CLI

Install the Forge CLI to create, test, and deploy apps right from your terminal.

[Start building](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/cli-reference/)

![UI Kit icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/AceRichIcon.svg)

#### UI Kit

Use pre-built, customizable components to craft app experiences that look and feel native to Atlassian.

[Explore UI Kit](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/user-interface/)

![Tutorials and guides icon](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/Guidelines.svg)

#### Tutorials and guides

Build a Hello World app and master the basics of Forge development.

[Read the docs](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/tutorials-and-guides/)

New

### Build on Teamwork Graph

Build Forge connectors that feed your data into Atlassian's context graph and apps that leverage its power. Your data becomes searchable, actionable, and AI-ready across the platform.

[Extend the graph](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/teamwork-graph/) [Explore the graph](https://www.teamworkgraph.com/)

![Teamwork Graph visualization](https://dac-static.atlassian.com/_static/teamwork-graph.svg)
